page.overview:
What is Nanohana?

Nanohana is a town in the Arabasta Kingdom. It is a port town known for its great shops and irresistible perfume. Notable residents include Kappa and Yoshimoto.

It was the Straw Hat Pirates' first stop during the Arabasta Arc, where they managed to re-supply and buy clothing for traversal of the Sandora Desert. It is also the place where Monkey D. Luffy reunited with his older brother, Portgas D. Ace, for the first time after leaving Foosha Village.

Nanohana is located south of Alubarna, east to the Sandora River and west of Katorea.

Nanohana resembles a typical middle-eastern desert town, following the conventions of Islamic architecture. It features a crowded and thriving bazaar. As expected of a port town, it has docks where ships can load up or unload cargo.
